tool.name: tantan
tool.description: probabilistic low-complexity intervals as content-annotated BED6
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$input' #else cat '$input' #end if | awk '/^>/{print;next}{print toupper(\$0)}' > in.fa && tantan -f3 in.fa | python3 '$__tool_directory__/lc_classify.py' in.fa - | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > '$output'
tool.help:
**tantan** (Martin Frith) runs probabilistic low-complexity repeat detection, well suited to AT-rich genomes.
The tool outputs **BED6** with content annotations (`name` = repeat-unit signature, `score` = purity × 1000, `strand` = `.`). It converts the input sequence to uppercase first so it computes the mask from sequence alone.
